data.narrative: Completed Module 6 graceful degradation - chose library-based circuit breaker (opossum/pybreaker) for battle-tested edge case handling, chose aggressive timeouts (500ms-1s) to keep server healthy during degradation. Implemented retry with exponential backoff (100ms base, 2s max, 50ms jitter) - only retry transient errors, cap at 3 retries. Implemented circuit breaker with three states (closed, open, half-open), failure threshold (5 failures in 30s), recovery timeout (30s). Fixed runaway retry failure by capping max retries at 3. Full degradation test passed: timeouts fire correctly, circuit opens/closes, fallback fast, backoff with jitter visible.

dimension_scores.observation: Module 6 directly implements failure thinking through graceful degradation patterns. Anticipated runaway retry failure (uncapped retries causing resource exhaustion). Distinguished transient errors (retry) from permanent errors (fail fast). Designed circuit breaker to prevent cascading failure from slow dependencies.
dimension_scores.evidence: Break step diagnosis: 'Root cause: maximum retry count removed or set to Infinity, retry loop runs indefinitely. Each retry spawns new timer, one slow request generates hundreds of retries holding resources'

dimension_scores.observation: Module 6 is degradation design - implemented circuit breaker (closed/open/half-open states), retry with exponential backoff and jitter, aggressive timeouts (500ms-1s), fallback responses (fast, independent of failing dependency). Full degradation test passed: timeouts fire, circuit opens/closes, fallback fast, recovery works.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verification summary: 'Circuit breaker opens after threshold, fallback response under 100ms, circuit closes after recovery through half-open state. Full degradation test passed'
